en: A vintage black-and-white image of a town square with prominent historic buildings. The main building features ornate architecture with a clock on its facade and a distinctive tower or steeple on top. Other visible details include signs for 'Kinematograph', 'Ratskeller', 'Heinrich Ploner', and 'Apotheke'. The top left of the postcard has red printed text in Fraktur script reading 'Colditz i. S. Markt.'
